subject: chemistry
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Oxygen gas can be identified because it:
Which ion do all acids release when dissolved in water?
questions.explain: Acids are substances that release hydrogen ions (H⁺) in aqueous solution.

questions.q: In a titration, which piece of apparatus delivers a precisely measured, fixed volume of one solution?
questions.explain: A pipette is used to measure an accurate fixed volume, while the burette delivers a variable volume.

questions.q: Where are non-metals generally found in the periodic table?
questions.explain: Non-metals are located on the right-hand side of the periodic table.

questions.q: What is produced when a Group 1 metal reacts with water?
questions.explain: Group 1 metals react with water to form a metal hydroxide and hydrogen gas.

questions.q: Which salt is formed when hydrochloric acid reacts with sodium hydroxide?
questions.explain: Hydrochloric acid produces chloride salts, so sodium chloride is formed.

questions.q: How does galvanising protect iron from rusting?
options: By adding carbon to the iron
By coating it with a layer of zinc
questions.explain: Galvanising coats iron with zinc, which acts as both a barrier and sacrificial protection.

questions.q: What is produced when an acid reacts with a metal oxide?
questions.explain: A metal oxide is a base, so acid + metal oxide → salt + water.

questions.q: Why are the Group 0 noble gases unreactive?
options: They have a full outer shell of electrons
questions.explain: Noble gases have full (stable) outer electron shells, so they rarely react.

questions.q: A pure substance, unlike a mixture, will:
options: Melt over a range of temperatures
Melt and boil at specific sharp temperatures
questions.explain: A pure substance has a sharp, specific melting and boiling point, whereas mixtures melt and boil over a range.

questions.q: Which metal will displace copper from copper sulfate solution?
questions.explain: Iron is more reactive than copper, so it displaces copper from copper sulfate solution.

questions.q: A period in the periodic table is a:
questions.explain: A period is a horizontal row; elements across a period gain electrons in the same shell.
